title: Configuration-check record (monthly)
description:
Dated pass/fail record posted by the scheduled configuration-check Lambda, which runs monthly against a fixed checklist: CloudTrail enabled and log-file validation on; no public S3 buckets; no security groups open to 0.0.0.0/0 on administrative ports; root account MFA; IAM password policy; KMS key rotation; ECR scan-on-push; DocumentDB backup retention and Multi-AZ. Each failed item is reviewed by the CEO and tracked to remediation. Cadence: monthly (automated evidence run).
